items.title: Hungarian authorities detain Viktor Orbán's younger brother for suspected human trafficking
items.summary: Former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán ‘s younger brother was taken into police custody on Monday, the new prime minister said, part of a probe into suspected human trafficking and influence peddling committed while the elder Orbán was still in office.
